entries.note: keyStatusCD; shipment information sent to FedEx.
keyStatusCD; picked up.
The sender's drop-off; seen with the details "Package received after final location pickup has occurred. Scheduled for pickup next business day." and the package flagged DY or SE.
keyStatusCD; arrived at FedEx location.
keyStatusCD; departed FedEx location.
keyStatusCD; in transit.
keyStatusCD; on FedEx vehicle for delivery.
Delivery option requested. With exception code A12 the recipient asked to hold the parcel at a location.
Hold at location request accepted; the parcel still travels to the location.
Written at the instant of an arrival at a FedEx location, before the departure from it: the address was corrected on the way.
keyStatusCD; the page puts it on its Ready for pickup step and shows the hold location. Adapter result status: out_for_delivery.
Ready for pickup (Hold at Location); the page dates its ready-for-pickup step from this scan. Adapter result status: out_for_delivery.
keyStatusCD; terminal, outranks the wording.
keyStatusCD; drives the page's own delivery-exception flag. Adapter result status: exception.
keyStatusCD; drives the page's own delay flag. A pickup received after the day's cutoff carries it too and reads as accepted.
keyStatusCD; shipment exception. A drop-off received after the location's last pickup carries it too, under the status "At dropoff point", and reads as accepted.
keyStatusCD; cancelled. The result vocabulary has no cancelled state, so it surfaces as exception.
Scan status; seen with the details "At FedEx location".
Pickup scan details; the package code can read DY meanwhile. The parcel leaves on the next business day.
AR's wording, a hub arrival; a copy relayed or stored without the code is the same scan.
The origin facility after the pickup.
The parcel left the origin facility.
Code RR: a delivery option the recipient asked for while the parcel still travels.
Adapter result status: in_transit.
Adapter result status: in_transit.
Customs released the parcel into the destination country: a completed clearance moves it on, as the shared wording rules read releases.
Export customs released the parcel at origin.
